items.title: Alibaba (NYSE:BABA) Is Supplying Moonshot With A Major Nvidia AI Cluster
items.summary: Alibaba Group Holding (NYSE:BABA) is supplying cloud infrastructure to support a major Nvidia chip cluster for Chinese AI firm Moonshot. The deal is designed to power Moonshot's next generation AI models that are being developed to compete with leading global systems. Alibaba is both a key cloud provider and a major investor in Moonshot, linking its cloud strategy directly to AI model development. Alibaba Group Holding has been working to grow its cloud computing and AI capabilities...
